objective: Implement the approved optional skill references metadata policy in GuidanceValidator. When optional references is present in skill YAML frontmatter, require a nonempty array of unique repository-relative paths to readable tracked regular files. Reject absolute paths, empty or non-string entries, traversal segments, missing or untracked files, directories, and symlink traversal (including parent directories). No references field preserves existing metadata behavior. Keep stable file-oriented diagnostics and no semantic approval claims. Document the behavior and add built-CLI regression tests before implementation. The captured verification command index 1 runs the guidance tests; index 0 rebuilds the CLI before final verification. Do not edit guidance content owned by agent-guidance. In the specification turn edit docs/guidance-validation.md and append built-CLI tests in tests/runtime/guidance.test.mjs, preserving existing scenarios. Give the assertion detecting unsupported references the explicit message GUIDANCE_REFERENCES_REQUIRED and return that exact literal as regression.outputIncludes with verificationIndex=1 and exitCode=1. Do not paraphrase actual test output.
expectedOutcome: Optional references field is deterministically validated without changing existing fields
